name: t04_pilot_overnight_budget_cpu_01

import unittest,sys
l=unittest.TestLoader()
s=unittest.TestSuite()
for p in ['test_e2e_budget.py', 'test_smoke_e2e_pilot.py', 'test_external_final_budget.py', 'test_mixed_phase_budget.py', 'test_gpu_pack_budget_integration.py', 'test_pbs_black_retry.py', 'test_pilot_black_retry.py', 'test_pbs_pack_black_retry.py']: s.addTests(l.discover("tests", pattern=p))
r=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=1).run(s)
raise SystemExit(0 if r.wasSuccessful() and not r.skipped else 1)
